pages.title: Fleet
pages.content:
The fleet

Forty-three machines live at Gate 3: micro and compact excavators, midi diggers, tracked and forward-tipping dumpers, ride-on rollers and site generators. Every machine is hired by the week, Monday to Friday, with delivery inside 25 km included.

pages.title: Hire week
pages.content:
How a hire week runs

A hire week starts with delivery to your site gate at 06:30 on Monday and ends with collection from 14:00 on Friday. In between, the hire desk rings on Tuesday, a fitter is on call on Wednesday and you can extend or call off until 15:00 on Thursday.

pages.title: Rates
pages.content:
Weekly rates

All rates are per hire week, Monday to Friday, ex VAT, with delivery inside 25 km included.

pages.title: The yard
pages.content:
The yard at Ferris Road

Kashidashi Hire was founded in 2004 by Tomasz Wierzbicki at Gate 3 of Ferris Road Works Yard in Eastmere. The yard is open Monday to Friday 06:00-18:00 and Saturday 07:00-12:00, closed on Sunday. Phone +00 20 7946 0388.

Tell us the site and the week

Send the site postcode, the machine you need and the start week. The hire desk answers within two working hours, Monday to Friday 06:00-18:00.

Get first call on returning machines

posts.title: Foundry Row: drains on a narrow terrace
posts.excerpt: A 3 t compact excavator with zero tail swing replaced a run of drains on a residential street in two weeks.
posts.content:
Foundry Row is a terrace of narrow houses with parked cars on both sides. The contractor needed a run of old drains replaced without closing the street, so the yard sent a 3 t compact excavator with zero tail swing and rubber tracks.

The machine was delivered to the gate at 06:30 on Monday with the hire sheet and key. On Wednesday our fitter checked the track tension, and on Friday of the second week it went back to Gate 3 after a signed return.
